items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-07
items.q: His daddy was nice towards our band. We used to play, it was Jay Day's home then.

ctx.x: Mm-hm. He told me he took lessons from Johnny, I didn't know that. He told me, Harry Sushant told me that.

Yeah, maybe he did, because Johnny's always, but Mr. Evans you tell him that now, since you called him, I had forgotten all about him. But he was a very, very fine young fellow, and wherever he'd be. His daddy was nice towards our band. We used to play, it was Jay Day's home then. You know we played one week, we used to go to Jay Day's home, before he opened the stove. And the whole band of us, you know, the drum and everybody, the drummers had a hard time. We used to go all upstairs and everything, all around…
Rigley, did you ever, when you were playing your trombone parts, try to echo the trumpet part or any other part?
